examples: Download everything the catalog holds about you, then delete the account.
how_to: Open the skills catalog while signed in. YOUR ACCOUNT has download my data (a JSON file) and delete my account. Deleting needs a sign in from the last 15 minutes and your handle typed exactly; it erases your installs, notes, unpublished submissions, ratings and comment text, signs out every device and removes the sign in account. Published skills stay under your retired handle.
media_exempt: the panel needs a signed in catalog account and the delete is destructive; its screenshot is captured in the pre-release recapture, not per change
name: Catalog account delete and export
summary: download your catalog data or delete your catalog account, with the erase finishing in the background if it is interrupted.
where: The skills catalog, YOUR ACCOUNT, under the signed in devices box.
